d: MASS MOBILE RV SERVICE LLC. is a female and veteran owned mobile RV repair business servicing Eastern Massachusetts east of I-495 and Cape Cod. It brings the shop to the RV and handles electrical, plumbing, propane diagnostics and repair, heat and A/C repairs, refrigeration, winterizing and de-winterizing, routine maintenance, pre-delivery inspections, new owner orientations and roof damage repair. It is a certified distributor and installer for Blaze Cut automatic fire suppression systems, is fully licensed and insured, and states it does not perform exterior body damage repairs or interior cleaning.

d: TRIC Mobile RV Repair is a family-owned on-site RV service serving Central Massachusetts, Northern Rhode Island and Northern Connecticut. Owner and lead technician Ryan Hadley is an RVTI Certified Technician and an RV PRO Top 40 Under 40 recipient. Repairs cover water heaters, furnaces, trailer brakes and wheel bearings, appliances, roof leaks, awnings and plumbing, along with winterization, maintenance and Sealtech leak detection. It is the official on-site service provider for Dreamhaven RV and does warranty work for major RV warranty companies.

d: RV Master Tech is a Cape Cod-based mobile RV service owned and operated by Jason Fitzgerald, an RVTI Level 4 Master Certified Technician and RVTAA Master Certified Technician with over nine years of experience. It brings repair, maintenance and upgrades to the customer's home, campsite or storage lot, from winterizations, appliance repairs and system troubleshooting to full roof replacements and interior renovations. It also handles hydraulic and electronic leveling systems, slide room repair, solar, awnings, and hitch and base plate installation, and offers winter watch inspections.

d: On-Site Mobile RV Repair is a mobile RV repair service covering Massachusetts and Rhode Island, driving a fully equipped service vehicle to the customer's campsite, storage lot or driveway. It handles rooftop AC units, furnaces, heat pumps and thermostats, fresh water systems, water heaters, pumps, holding tanks and winterization, roof and leak repair, inverters, converters, batteries and 12V/120V troubleshooting, and RV appliance repair. It also does hitching and tow setup, including fifth wheel hitches and brake controller installation, and fiberglass and body work.

d: Clean Slate RV Repair is a mobile RV repair business based in Carver, Massachusetts, bringing on-site service across the South Shore, South Coast and Cape Cod. It handles furnace repair and upgrades, water heater service, absorption refrigerator repair, A/C cleaning and replacement, roof sealing, RV plumbing repair, 12V and 120V electrical work, and slideout servicing and repair. It is based in Carver and covers Plymouth, Bristol and Barnstable counties including Middleborough, Bourne, New Bedford, Fall River, Yarmouth and Sandwich.

d: Route 44 RV Collision Center in Lakeville, Massachusetts is an RV collision repair and RV services shop with large, well-lit service bays and a spray booth for body and paint work. RV services include oil changes, wheel balancing, brake work, air-conditioning services, windshield replacement, reconditioning, generator repair and winterizing. It offers free insurance estimates after a collision and licensed collision and fiberglass repair with paint matching.
